stories.title: Russia frees American Stephen Hubbard; Putin agrees to resume Ukraine peace talks
stories.line: Russia freed American prisoner Stephen Hubbard as Putin agreed to resume Ukraine peace talks, drawing criticism over the concessions involved.

stories.title: Airbnb bars hosts from making guests strip beds, do dishes, or take out trash
stories.line: Airbnb now bars hosts from requiring guests to strip beds, do dishes, laundry, or take out trash before checkout, starting November 20.

stories.title: Pope Leo needs no further treatment after lung cancer surgery, Vatican says
stories.line: Pope Leo XIV's doctors say his lung cancer surgery succeeded and he needs no further treatment.

stories.title: Jury orders Meta to pay $25 billion over deceiving users on privacy
stories.line: A New Mexico jury found Meta liable for deceiving users about privacy and ordered it to pay $25 billion.

stories.title: Costumed 'Batman' in London pays fines and buys meals for hard-up Brits
stories.line: A costumed London man known as 'Batman' is handing out petrol money, parking-fine payments and cheap meals to struggling residents.

stories.title: US orders some staff out of Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks continue
stories.line: The US is ordering some personnel out of Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks on the kingdom continue almost daily.

stories.title: Ramaswamy's ad targeting Amy Acton's mother draws criticism from Republicans
stories.line: Ohio's GOP gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy's attack ad featuring Amy Acton's estranged mother is drawing bipartisan criticism, including from Vance and Haley.

stories.title: Texas Senate race tightens as Neil Bush backs Democrat Talarico over Paxton
stories.line: Texas Senate race between Republican Ken Paxton and Democrat James Talarico is tightening, with some GOP figures breaking ranks.

stories.title: U.S. and Israel draw up plans for renewed Iran strikes as Tehran keeps its uranium
stories.line: The U.S. and Israel are reportedly drafting plans for renewed strikes on Iran after its elections, with Tehran refusing to give up its uranium.

stories.title: Democrats sue to stop Trump from taking over state election administration
stories.line: Democrats sued to block the Trump administration from taking over state control of how elections are run, and over alleged voter intimidation.
